items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow (same as prior injury), ruled out; X-rays negative for fracture, additional testing Monday; expected to miss time (previously ~4 games/month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on freak play bracing fall; no fracture but further tests for ligaments/surgery possibility.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks likely; Commanders turn to backup QB, major downgrade for WAS pass catchers ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Last similar injury missed ~month; Rapoport notes expected miss time.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, carted off; walking under own power with slight limp postgame, MRI/tests Monday; severity TBD but mobility key to game.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring on scramble; carted but good spirits/walking later.
items.implication: Potential multi-week absence or caution; CHI pass catchers (Odunze, Moore, Loveland) face uncertainty, backup QB impact.
items.opportunity: Walking positive sign vs worse alternatives; ETR watching closely.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE; was GTD with optimism/flak jacket possible.
items.why: Officially active after weekend reports of optimism he can go.
items.implication: Startable with possible docks/reduced effectiveness from rib; reverse any prior pivots.
items.opportunity: Levitan projected in with docks; Rap bullish tone.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) true game-time decision for MNF; missed practices, pre-game decision.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness, no practice Fri/Sat; true GTD.
items.implication: Have pivot ready (Adams primary, TE/Ferguson/Mumpfield bumps if out); high risk start.
items.opportunity: Schefter: pre-game decision; Whittington also doubtful.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans hip injury not serious per Shanahan; could have returned Q4 if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.why: Hip Q in-game but Shanahan: not serious, could return.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3; monitor but low long-term concern.

items.text: Raiders HC Kubiak on TE Brock Bowers (knee): 'Close, very close. He looks great.' Missed W2 (doubtful/inactive), eyeing Week 3.
items.why: Limited practice, pregame warmup; coach very optimistic post W2.
items.implication: Elite TE1 if active W3 vs NO; Mayer loses role.
items.opportunity: Rapoport earlier: could return next week.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) Q to return in-game, did return limited (MRI upcoming); watching closely postgame.
items.why: Stinger early, returned 2nd half limited touches; MRI Monday.
items.implication: Possible limited/miss W3; Bigsby/Shipley handcuff value spiked.
items.opportunity: Returned same game positive but neck/stinger caution.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive; grab Jonah Coleman as beneficiary.
items.why: Hamstring; not expected and confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Opens RB work for backups; stash/add Coleman for volume.
items.opportunity: ETR/Levitan expected decent look at Coleman.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck/head) ruled OUT; has feeling/movement all extremities, overnight hospital observation.
items.why: Neck injury early, carted; positive neuro signs but further testing.
items.implication: Miss at least W2; monitor W3, Wicks/others bump.
items.opportunity: ETR watching; Schefter update on feeling/movement.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) and Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) both ACTIVE; Olave clean no docks.
items.why: Officially active; ETR expected to play, Levitan no real docks for Olave.
items.implication: Full or near-full roles; start with confidence.

items.text: Colts WR Michael Pittman (foot) OUT; expecting decent look at Germie Bernard (YAC fit with McCarthy).
items.implication: Bernard stash/upgrade opportunity in deep leagues; Pittman miss.
items.opportunity: Berry agrees Bernard good McCarthy fit/YAC.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) OUT; opens door for Bateman/others.
items.implication: Target share to Bateman/Andrews; Flowers downgrade ROS short-term.
items.opportunity: Rapoport notes need big game from Bateman.

items.text: Seahawks WR Jaxon Smith-Njigba: 9/155/3 TDs; 5th WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yds, TD in each of first two games.
items.implication: WR1 lock ROS; massive upgrade signal.

items.text: Packers RB Marshawn Lloyd first career TD; those waiting 2+ years congrats.
items.why: Scored first career TD amid Packers backfield.
items.implication: Handcuff/breakout watch if role expands (Jones injury watch).
